description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on end wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa sits in the upper-right area facing the central living zone; an additional armchair/seating near the dining table; dining table with 6 seats positioned mid-right facing the living space and TV area. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible, 14 m² — large enough for bunk beds. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 1 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobes anywhere); large families requiring more than two bedrooms; anyone wanting a private quiet sleeping zone far from the open living area; people who require a separate enclosed kitchen.
